issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies Pneumatic.raisePressure(int) with a void return type, but the solution implements Pneumatic.raisePressure(int) returning boolean. This mismatch in method return type contradicts the specification and will confuse or block students when they try to implement/declare the interface and its implementing classes according to the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Pneumatic interface's raisePressure(int) return type consistent with the UML/problem statement by changing its signature to void raisePressure(int pressureIncrease); and update all implementing classes (LaunchedDropdownTower, LaunchedRollerCoaster) to implement the void-returning method. Alternatively, if the intended design is to return boolean, update the problem statement UML and task descriptions to specify a boolean return type.
